notes: DUPLICATE PERSON RECORD (research 2026-07-03): this record and I182541959332 are the same individual duplicated under separate internal IDs — identical birth/death dates, same spouse (Samuel Pond) and child (Hannah Pond); this copy adds the mother, Mary Oliver, whereas I182541959332 lists only 'Isaac Stowell Jr.' as parent. Her birth (26 Sep 1772) and death (21 Aug 1829) dates, both at Dedham, are independently corroborated by Edward D. Harris, A Genealogical Record of Daniel Pond, and His Descendants (1873), pp. 100-102, entry #383, which records Samuel Pond's 1803 marriage to 'Hannah Stowell, b. 26 Sep. 1772, d. Dedham, 21 Aug. 1829' — matching exactly.
